parameterRationale.revenue: Separate product and service assumptions; near-term growth is anchored to September guidance and H2 outlook. The FY2030/31 interpolation is below the CY2030 management midpoint. Packaging is embedded, not added again.
parameterRationale.margin: Analyst economic margin assumption after recurring equity compensation: 42.5% initial, 44.5% peak, 39.5% terminal. Other operating costs are an algebraic residual including D&A, not an independent bottom-up forecast. Margins are 50 bp below v2 because recurring compensation rises from 2.5% to 3.0% without offsetting cost changes.
parameterRationale.capital: FY2026 identified NWC investment1235.857 and net investment1217.824 imply sales/capital1.169. Base1.5–1.6 normalizes against incomplete five-year trade proxy2.188. Final same-period sales/capital adjusts ROIC/after-tax margin by 1/(1+g), matching the terminal reinvestment timing.
parameterRationale.SBC: 3.0% recurring new-grant economic compensation is benchmarked to FY24–26 gross grant-value proxies of 2.93%, 2.79%, 2.90%, which include maximum performance grants. Legacy 558.1 schedule is an explicit presentation bridge only: it is subtracted and reversed in equal amounts, never creating an uplift. Existing awards are diluted once. Sensitivities hold residual non-SBC costs fixed.
parameterRationale.costOfCapital: Source observations and dates are explicit. Target leverage, issuer spread and mature beta are analyst assumptions. No price or desired valuation is used to fit discount rates.
parameterRationale.guidance: Only three recent upcycle quarters were paired. They do not establish a ten-year reliability score and receive no valuation confidence premium.
parameterRationale.tax: Management planning rate 14.5% anchors the near term; analyst path fades to 21%. Singapore tax holidays expire through December 2032. No statutory claim is made that all income will be taxed at 21%.
parameterRationale.terminal: Base growth3.5%, downside3.0%, each equal last explicit growth and below adjusted USD risk-free4.87%. Reinvestment equals g/ROIC times NOPAT. Timing-adjusted terminal sales/capital is ROIC/((1+g)*after-tax margin), ensuring reinvestment grows at the same stable rate.

equityCompensationMethod.rationale: 3.0% is slightly above the FY2024–FY2026 gross grant-value proxies of approximately 2.93%, 2.79%, 2.90%. It recognizes recurring economic employee cost immediately, not a claim about GAAP amortization. The old 2.5% assumption is retained only as a lower-cost sensitivity.
equityCompensationMethod.costBasis: Operating costs excluding all equity compensation are a residual normalization from an analyst margin assumption, and include D&A. They are not an independently estimated bottom-up cash-cost forecast. V3 preserves V2 residual costs and increases new-grant costs by 0.5% of revenue, reducing economic EBIT margins by 50 bp.
equityCompensationMethod.sensitivityPolicy: Hold non-SBC residual cost dollars fixed when changing recurring compensation; do not adjust those costs to restore the original margin. Hold sales/capital fixed in one-factor sensitivities; terminal ROIC may therefore change consistently.
equityCompensationMethod.legacyPolicy: Explicitly subtract the remaining 558.1 legacy amortization from economic earnings to illustrate GAAP-like earnings, then reverse the same amount. This produces no legacy valuation uplift. Full legacy RSU dilution is used once at the origin. Future grants are expensed economically and are not also diluted.
equityCompensationMethod.taxPolicy: Normalized tax rates apply to economic EBIT. No separate cash tax benefit for legacy award vesting is assumed; actual deduction timing/amount is uncertain.
